notes: Corrected: the *when* of *but when they sought him* was marked `added`; under rule 55 the contiguous *but when* at the recast clause's left edge is one rendering of the waw of `וַיְבַקְשֻׁהוּ`.
Variant unit WLC.1SA.10.21.v002 is selected to the base reading `לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָיו`, which the ASV's *by their families* renders directly; no exclusion arises under rule 53.
